Eye and limb malformations define disease; developmental delay in 3/4, intellectual disability and cleft lip each reported in 30-79%.
Hyperkeratotic lesions confined to the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Primary endometrial carcinoma; reproductive site has no axis. Histologic resemblance to lung carcinoma does not indicate pulmonary disease.
Clonal blood and marrow neoplasm with myelodysplastic and myeloproliferative features.
Generic muscle-derived mesenchymal neoplasm classified under musculoskeletal benign neoplasms; no specific visceral organ of origin supplied.
Profound intellectual disability and skeletal abnormalities define syndrome; cataracts reported in 30-79%.
Pressure-induced skin and underlying soft-tissue necrosis; deeper bone involvement is not established as common.
Vertebral skeletal dysplasia with kyphoscoliosis and adult joint degeneration; spinal cord compression lacks evidence of frequency >=30%.
Multiple subcutaneous lipomas; thrombocytopenia occurs in only 1-4%. Fat proliferation alone is not a metabolic disorder.
Invasive urothelial carcinoma originating in the renal pelvis or ureter, both within the renal axis.
Vitamin deficiency defined broadly by low B12; anemia and neuropathy are variable, and this record does not establish either in >=30% across the group.
Hereditary colorectal cancer syndrome; other associated cancers are separate diseases and do not establish additional organ damage.
Storage disorder with defining cardiovascular calcification; thrombocytopenia and corneal opacity each 30-79%. Hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver dysfunction; other neurologic signs <30%.
Urea-cycle disorder; hyperammonemic encephalopathy is a defining neonatal presentation, with seizures, cerebral edema and potential lasting deficits.
EYS-related rod-cone retinal degeneration with progressive visual loss.
Fibrosing bronchiolar obstruction; the defined syndrome is mainly chronic lung-allograft dysfunction mediated by alloimmune injury. Non-transplant causes vary.
Carcinoma in situ confined to breast tissue, which has no axis.
Hypomyelinating neuropathy and congenital contractures define disease; vocal cord paralysis causes laryngeal dysfunction in 1/1 assessed patient, with limited sample certainty.
PDE6B-related rod-cone retinal degeneration; cataract is within the same ocular axis.
Neurodevelopmental syndrome with developmental delay, microcephaly and postural instability; joint limitations occur in only 5-29%.
Inherited neurodegenerative disease; additional organ damage is not established across its constituent disorders.
Malignant neoplasm originating in cutaneous apocrine sweat glands.
Pain disorder defined by peripheral nerve distribution and classified as peripheral neuropathy; no additional organ injury is intrinsic.
Constitutional neutropenia and immunoglobulin deficiency with recurrent infections; osteoporosis, fractures and osseous anomalies are defining features.
